name: chat_edit
description: Edit your own chat message. Only the original sender can edit. The message is marked as edited with a timestamp. Returns the updated message id and edited timestamp.
llm_description: Edit your own chat message (sender-only); marks it edited with a timestamp. Input: {msg_id, text (max 4096 chars)}. The message is identified by msg_id alone; there is no room. Returns updated message id and edited timestamp.
